items.docs:
listUsers takes the following options:

withPicture - to include the full size and thumbnail user picture urls

withRoles - to include the user's roles

withUserSites - to include the user's sites

ignoreSiteSpecificAccess - bypasses site specific access checks

withBuildings - includes nested building/floor/units attached to the user

isAttachedToAtLeastOneIntercom - filters to just users attached to an intercom

withRealUserGroups - to in

info.name: Generate new cloudKey unlock token for a specific entry.

The response includes key fields with the following meanings:

**cloudKeyUnlockToken**: returns the unlock token authorized to unlock the specified entries.

**apiUrl**: returns the URL that, if POST-ed to, will immediately unlock the specified entries. E.g. curl -XPOST https://api.openpath.com/tokens/....../use immediately unlocks the specified entries.
